name: Control Evidence Review
problem: Audit preparation is often a list of documents without a clear way to judge evidence sufficiency, freshness or ownership.
method: Define an explicitly scoped set of controls and expected evidence.
Mark evidence as received, missing, stale or under review.
Separate evidence presence from evidence effectiveness.
Escalate overdue gaps to a named owner and retest after remediation.
decision: Is the scoped set ready for reviewer attention, conditionally ready with exceptions, or blocked?
note: A readiness exercise is not an independent SOC 2 audit or ISO/IEC 27001 certification.

name: Vendor Decision Desk
problem: Due-diligence questionnaires are difficult to prioritize if service criticality, data use, missing proof and residual risk are mixed together.
method: Identify service dependency, data categories, AI and subprocessors.
Assign a transparent, illustrative inherent-risk tier.
Gather proportionate security, privacy and continuity evidence.
State conditions, decision owner and reassessment trigger.
decision: Proceed with conditions, request more evidence, or escalate for formal acceptance?
note: Scoring is illustrative; legal obligations and organizational risk appetite must be independently checked.

name: AI Use-Case Gate
full: AI Governance Intake & Human Review Gate
problem: AI experiments can enter workflows without consistent inventory, owner, impact review and monitored release conditions.
method: Capture intended use, affected users, data sensitivity and accountability.
Assess impact, autonomy, external exposure and vendor involvement.
Identify required evaluation evidence and human oversight.
Record a bounded approve, condition, defer or stop recommendation.
decision: What evidence and ownership are needed before the illustrative use case can proceed?
frameworks: NIST AI RMF 1.0: GOVERN / MAP / MEASURE / MANAGE
note: Not an AI safety certification, legal applicability decision or actual deployment authorization.

name: Trust Answer Library
full: Customer Security Assurance & Approved Answer Library
problem: Repeated customer security questionnaires produce contradictory answers and unsupported promises.
method: Classify question intent and business context.
Link answers to approved evidence and accountable owners.
Add expiration and escalation fields.
Release only language supported by current proof.
decision: Release the response, revise for evidence, or escalate for approval?
note: Questionnaire responses require real organizational approval and reviewed evidence.

name: Risk Signal Brief
problem: Risk registers often contain metrics without thresholds or a clear management action.
method: Classify material risk themes and owners.
Define useful leading and lagging indicators.
Flag appetite breaches separately from ordinary trends.
Translate signal into one accountable management request.
decision: What must an executive approve or escalate?
note: Example thresholds must be calibrated to the real organization.

name: Transparency Checkpoint
problem: Transparency guidance is often quoted without making evidence, implementation owner and product context explicit.
method: Document product and interaction context.
Determine which requirements might apply and flag uncertainties.
Propose disclosure controls and capture proof.
Route applicability questions to qualified legal review.
decision: Is the example ready for legal and governance review?
frameworks: EU AI Act (applicability requires legal review)
note: Not legal advice; exact duties and effective dates must be checked before use.

name: Data-Use Boundary
problem: Unapproved AI use can cause sensitive information to flow outside controlled channels.
method: Inventory example tools and intended uses.
Classify data and destination boundaries.
Specify allowed, conditional and prohibited patterns.
Provide an accountable exception route.
decision: Allow, restrict, migrate or stop the usage pattern?
note: No claim of monitoring or preventing actual enterprise data loss.

name: Assurance Triage
problem: Unstructured questionnaires waste reviewer effort and allow unapproved commitments.
method: Cluster questions into security, privacy and resilience topics.
Map topics to response evidence.
Escalate unsupported claims.
Track approved answer expiry.
decision: Answer, hold or escalate each requested statement?
note: No automated approval of supplier assurances.

name: Processor Review
problem: Data processing terms may be reviewed without connecting subprocessor changes to controls and exceptions.
method: Record controller/processor roles as hypotheses.
Assess contract and subprocessor evidence.
Track material exceptions and owner response.
Require legal review for uncertain obligations.
decision: What needs legal or procurement review before acceptance?
note: Illustrative only; no legal determination or compliant-contract guarantee.

name: Control Follow-Through
problem: Evidence expires and exceptions linger between periodic audit cycles.
method: Set evidence review intervals and defined owners.
Track age, missing items and open retests.
Separate visibility from control effectiveness.
Bring overdue gaps to decision-makers.
decision: Which items must be reverified or escalated this review cycle?
note: A sample review cadence does not demonstrate live enterprise monitoring.
